purpose: Execution-reconstruction specifications for the principal C1-C3 paths, identifying the recorded source, contract, model, workload, and environment inputs.

C1.evidence_status: Recorded source and contract packaged; rebuilding requires the pinned model, runtime toolchain, hardware/resource controls, and local path bindings. Each resulting run has its own execution identity.

C2.evidence_status: Recorded source and contract packaged; rebuilding requires the pinned model, runtime toolchain, storage and hardware identities, resource controls, and local path bindings.

C3-qwen.evidence_status: Recorded fault-instrumented source and contract packaged; rebuilding requires the pinned model, runtime toolchain, hardware/resource controls, and local path bindings.

C3-gemma.evidence_status: Recorded fault-instrumented source and contract packaged; rebuilding requires provider-authorized model acquisition, the pinned runtime toolchain, hardware/resource controls, and local path bindings.
